claim: In the XMapEdit tutorial DOOR-CURTAINS a push opens a curtain sector by XWALLs on the surface the player pushes, not by trigger_wall_push on the sector: s3, s6 and s8 each listen on their own channel and are shoved through three wall buttons, and the sector keeps its one tx free.
evidence: DOOR-CURTAINS s3: walls 38, 39, 40 carry tx 100 (command 3, trigger_push) while the sector is only rx 100; s6 and s8 the same on channels 103 and 104 (maps/blood/mechanism, python -m tools.catalog show lesson:DOOR-CURTAINS)
use: Put the push trigger on the walls the player touches.

checked.how: catalog record maps/blood/mechanism/Vanilla/DOOR-CURTAINS.map: sector 3 type 614, rx_id 100, no tx; walls 38, 39, 40 tx_id 100, command 3, trigger_push 1, picnum 146. catalog show lesson:DOOR-CURTAINS: s6 (channel 103) and s8 (104) likewise 'shoved through 3 wall button(s)'. One tutorial map, worded as what the tutorials do; the xmapedit manual page not opened.
